result.title: Stop Going in Circles:Loop-Triggered Routing for System 1 Decision Agents
result.summary: System 1 decision models (represented by Jev) provide fast, low-cost action selection, but existing agent integrations do not reliably translate these local advantages into task completion. At certain points during execution, an agent may repeatedly select the same actions without making progress toward its goal. LLM-based policies offer strong reasoning capabilities that support planning within an agent, but invoking them at every step incurs substantial overhead. The effective coordination should therefore preserve Jev's fast local action selection while introducing LLM reasoning when execution stalls. We observe that recurring state-action pairs can signal stalled execution. We therefore propose LoopRoute, a simple but effective action router that uses this signal to allocate control within an agent. The decision model acts by default. When a loop is detected, the LLM provides brief, feedback-driven assistance and then returns control to the decision model. Later loops can request further assistance. The rule requires neither additional training nor model-specific confidence calibration. Across three benchmarks and seven LLMs, LoopRoute improves task success over standalone Jev with only limited use of the LLM policy. The mean gains are 21.0%, 60.1%, and 30.1% on ALFWorld, MapReader, and TextWorld cooking, respectively. Compared with full LLM control, LoopRoute also substantially reduces the mean cumulative API time and API-call cost per task. The same rule also improves the success rates of six frozen decision models.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LoopRoute：默认由 System 1 决策模型（Jev）选动作，当检测到重复 state-action 对形成的循环时，调用 LLM 给出简短反馈式协助再交回控制权；在 ALFWorld、MapReader、TextWorld cooking 三个基准和七个 LLM 上提升成功率，同时降低 LLM 调用时间与成本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「用停滞信号触发昂贵推理、完成后恢复廉价策略」的免训练路由规则，可能与 LVR 中 THINK/STOP 的计算分配与切换判据相关，可供核查；但该工作为纯文本 agent 任务、无视觉表征或 latent 状态，迁移有效性需自行检验。
